correctness.rationale: The verifier implements a complete recursion. In a squarefree word every proper border has length less than half the word, and the longest border inherits all shorter borders. Thus every candidate with r borders is exactly of the recursively enumerated form u v u with u having at least r-1 borders. Alphabet relabeling justifies fixing the first symbol to 0. The program independently reproduces the published minima 1,3,7,23,59 and then proves the next minimum is 142; the displayed witness has exactly five proper borders.

value.rationale: This is the first missing exact value in a published extremal sequence whose source explicitly gives only the first five values and says its general bound is not optimal. The current OEIS entry still requests additional terms. The result therefore supplies a natural next calibration point for a named combinatorics-on-words invariant, with a complete lower-bound certificate rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
